about: Two observatories for the whole-circle horizon check (test/horizon.test.mjs). Kitt Peak: the planner's default site with its elevation (src/plan/sites.js, from the astropy site registry: 31.96333 N, 111.6 W, 2120 m; the tiles' ground there is 2059 m, so the eye is put at 2120 + 2 m, as the planner does); Mauna Kea: the summit ridge near the UH 2.2 m telescope (19.8230 N, 155.4694 W), the eye 2 m above the tiles' ground.
